name: sel-subset-claims
notes: Companion to pit-selector-changed: once the vitest adapter declares `selector-relation` and proves a prefix narrowing (baseline selector `[]` -> current selector `['src']`), the comparator MAY claim `subset` -- but §6.1 bounds exactly what it may say. `src/gone.test.ts` is rewritten under a new title between A and B: its old (red) test_id vanishes while still being selector-in-scope (matchesFn 'yes' for the 'src' token), so it is `removed`, never a false `repaired`. `tests/out.test.ts` (red) falls outside the narrowed selector (matchesFn 'no'): §6.1 MUST still disclose it, in the dedicated `out_of_scope` bucket, distinct from `removed` and never claimed as `repaired`. `src/a.test.ts` stays green and unremarked in both runs. The `selector-subset` surface event carries both selectors and the proving capability (`selector-relation`), the comparator-side half of the §11.1 gate MUST exercised by sel-subset-gate.

steps.message: seed src green + src red + tests red
rewrite gone.test.ts under a new title (green), unrelated to scope narrowing
